etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From Middle English deriven, from Old French deriver, from Latin dērīvō (“to lead, turn, or draw off (a liquid), draw off, derive”), from dē (“away”) + rīvus (“a stream”); see rival. Unrelated to arrive.
senses: (transitive) To obtain or receive (something) from something else.
(transitive, logic) To deduce (a conclusion) by reasoning.
